description: Chrome DevTools MCP UI edge cases — Phase 8. Run with frontend on FRONTEND_URL and ops.admin logged in.
prerequisites: Newman run 5 or fixtures.py produced applicationId in .e2e-runs/edge-fixtures.json

cases.title: Browser refresh preserves session on loan detail
cases.pass: Session cookie valid; page shows loan data after refresh

cases.title: No console errors on primary screens
Failed network shows ErrorState
steps: Assert user-visible error state (not blank screen)
cases.pass: ErrorState or equivalent error UI visible

cases.title: Empty list states
steps: Apply filters that yield zero results (e.g. status + date impossible combo)
cases.pass: Empty state copy visible; table not broken

cases.title: Pagination boundaries on audit
steps: Navigate to last page of audit results
Assert page controls disabled appropriately on last page

cases.title: Filter combinations on loan applications
steps: Assert list updates and URL/query reflects filters
cases.pass: Combined filters apply; results consistent with API

cases.title: UI status matches API
cases.pass: UI status string matches API status enum

cases.title: UI does not poll after external API status change
steps: POST status transition via API (or mock disburse) without UI action
cases.pass: Expected Fail — documents UC-053 known gap until polling added
